slides.title: Can't *add a row* in SE16?
slides.voiceover: Can't add a row in SE16? Last time we learned the delivery class. Now, the data browser setting.
slides.spoken: Can't add a row in SE16? Last time we learned the delivery class. Now, the data browser setting.

slides.label: NEW TERM
slides.heading: One *switch* decides
slides.body: Data Browser/Table View Maint. = may SE16 and SM30 show and change this table's rows?
slides.voiceover: One field decides if SE16 and SM30 may show and change your table's rows.
slides.spoken: One field decides if SE16 and SM30 may show and change your table's rows.

slides.heading: Where it *lives*
slides.voiceover: In SE11, open the Delivery and Maintenance tab. Below the delivery class is Data Browser, Table View Maint. F4 shows three options.
slides.spoken: In SE11, open the Delivery and Maintenance tab. Below the delivery class is Data Browser/Table View Maint. F4 shows 3 options.

slides.label: THE 3 OPTIONS
slides.heading: What each *option* allows
slides.title: Data Browser/Table View Maint. (F4)
slides.voiceover: Allowed: SE16 shows and changes rows, and SM30 works. With restrictions: SE16 only shows them. No changes, no SM30. Not allowed: neither tool can touch the table.
slides.spoken: Allowed: SE16 shows and changes rows, and SM30 works. With restrictions: SE16 only shows them. No changes, no SM30. Not allowed: neither tool can touch the table.

slides.label: COMMON MISTAKE
slides.heading: SM30 says *restrictions*
slides.voiceover: Common mistake: SM30 maintenance on a table left on restrictions. SM30 then refuses to maintain it. Switch it to allowed.
slides.spoken: Common mistake: SM30 maintenance on a table left on restrictions. SM30 then refuses to maintain it. Switch it to allowed.

slides.label: EXAMPLE
slides.heading: A *real* table
slides.title: Delivery and Maintenance tab
slides.voiceover: Real example: T zero zero one, company codes, is allowed. Set your test table to allowed to add rows in SE16.
slides.spoken: Real example: T001, company codes, is allowed. Set your test table to allowed to add rows in SE16.

slides.label: REMEMBER
slides.heading: *Restrictions* = look, don't touch
slides.body: Allowed: change in SE16 and SM30. With Restrictions: display only. Not Allowed: no standard tool.
slides.voiceover: Takeaway: with restrictions, you can look, but you can't touch.
slides.spoken: Takeaway: with restrictions, you can look, but you can't touch.
